message: ハロウィンパニック

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh yeah, today's Halloween, isn't it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sirloin?」

name: Sally
message: 「What's that」

name: Misa
message: 「It's beef steak」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, you mean beefsteak!?」

name: Ria
message: 「No, not that\s02 Halloween is a festival celebrating the autumn harvest」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aha. That's the one where they go, 'Are there any naughty kids around?' right」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's Namahage!」

name: Ria
message: 「Actually, kids dress up in costumes and get candy from adults」

name: Sally
message: 「Seriously!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's do Halloween!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Costumes, huh... Synn's house probably has stuff like Groucho glasses, at least」

name: Synn
message: 「We don't keep anything that isn't practical」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bullcrap!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally already looks like she's wearing a costume, so... maybe she's fine just as she is?」

name: Sally
message: 「Really!? Lucky me♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let's put Extra in the lead and go get some candy~~」

name: Sally
message: 「Truck of Treatment」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, now that you mention it, it is Halloween」
She figured it out from just that.

name: Sally
message: 「So anyway, BOSS, hand over the candy!」

name: Helena
message: 「Very well. Here is your reward for this mission」
In the end, we borrowed costumes from the drama club and played pretend Halloween.
Helena-san pulls a mugwort rice cake from her sleeve and presents it to Sally. It's a scene I've seen somewhere before.

name: Sally
message: 「Yaaay, thank youuu!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Extra, keep that momentum going and get one more!」

name: Sally
message: 「No way」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then there was no point in making you the top first-year!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. Here you go」
Next, Ria-senpai brought out some mame daifuku.
I see, you could certainly tell these two were sisters by blood.
However, Lolotte, the person in question, had a gloomy look on her face.

name: Ria
message: 「What's wrong? Did you not like these?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm afraid I cannot accept this from you, Senpai-san」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Halloween is a time when you receive sweets from adults. Even if you are Senpai-san, in the eyes of the world, you are still a child」
What a terrifying girl, calling Ria-senpai a child.

name: Helena
message: 「Kh, kuku... pfft!」
Helena-san literally held her stomach and laughed. Meanwhile, Ria-senpai had been in a daze for a while now.

name: Helena
message: 「Ahaha, that's hilarious. Calling Ria a child--you sure say some funny things」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not funny~~!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ria is an adult. After all--」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaah」

name: Helena
message: 「Where in the world would you find a child with a chest this impressive?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-no, everyone's watching~~」

name: Helena
message: 「Or is it that you're a child on the inside, and only your body is an a-d-u-l-t?」

name: Sally
message: 「So having huge boobs makes you an adult~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then smaller is better. As long as I can still get candy, I want to stay a child」
Should I call her innocent, or what.

name: Helena
message: 「Mmmm~. It feels so nice, just like a daifuku~~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Stop that, Helena-san. It's bad for their education」

name: Helena
message: 「Hehe... Hey, Synn-chan. Which do you prefer, small or big?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Helena
message: 「If you don't answer, I won't stop」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way...」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Synn-kun. Ah, noooo~」
Taking Ria-senpai hostage--how underhanded can she get.
Still, at this rate, I'll―no, Ria―senpai will end up in serious trouble.
I have no choice. Steeling my resolve, I shout.

name: Synn
message: 「Big breasts are better!」

name: Helena
message: 「Nobody said anything about breasts」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk」
Wait, she meant the size of the daifuku? That's way too confusing!

name: Helena
message: 「Just kidding\s04 I see, I see~. So Synn-chan is a proper boy after all~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, you're always teasing people like that! *Smack!*」
She could have stopped her like that from the very beginning without me embarrassing myself.

name: Helena
message: 「Fufufu. Honesty is a virtue」

name: Sally
message: 「*Munch, munch.* Cheer up, Prez」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Nom, nom.* People's tastes vary wildly」

name: Synn
message: 「So you're eating them after all. And you changed clothes so fast!」

name: Helena
message: 「So. Even though it's Halloween, what happened to the pumpkins?」

name: Sally
message: 「Pumpkins?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It says here that wearing a pumpkin head is the traditional formal attire for Halloween」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoaaa~~. If you wear something like that, it really is a costume party」
Does nobody realize that until just a moment ago, Sally-chan was inside that pumpkin.

name: Helena
message: 「It can't be helped. Just wear this for now」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh!? Kyaa!!」
She placed an expensive-looking pot right over Ria-senpai's head.
Even Ria-senpai is completely outmatched in front of Helena-san.

name: Helena
message: 「Halloween monsters really have to look like this, after all. Here, some candy」

name: Ria
message: 「――Pwah!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you okay?」

name: Ria
message: 「Haa, haa... Synn-kun, thank you...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho~. So monsters are what you're after. In that case, Omake-san's Boss would probably get even more candy」

name: Sally
message: 「Lolo-chi, great idea! Alriiiight, next time I'll bring Boss along too!」

name: Helena
message: 「Fufufu. I'll be looking forward to it\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, Big Sis! Even for you, I won't forgive you for today~~!」

name: Helena
message: 「Even if I said I'd give you kashiwa mochi?」
It seems Ria-senpai still has plenty of a childish side left in her.
